description:
Why: every step result in a lowered body gets its own transport-shape product (jobs/artifact.rs, the step_result_values loop). A literal built from constants, such as [a: 1] or %{start: 0, length: 3}, lowers to one step per part, so its cost grows with its size even though its value is known at compile time. A quote is the extreme case: everything in it except its unquotes is constant, yet each node lowers as a head atom, a metadata list, an argument list and a tuple. Measured at develop 458eb43eb (Callables, lowerer counting probe, since restored): compiling the distiller lowers 117 all-constant source literals (107 steps for their parts) and 11 quotes (361 steps, 265 of them inside subtrees with no unquote, which would become 20 constants), 352 step values in all, against 46,956 total requests. Fixture 00181 lowers 9 quotes to 310 steps, 236 of them in constant subtrees that would become 15 constants; 229 step values in all.

What (composite half; awaiting the user's ruling on the proposal page https://claude.ai/artifact/1NmkMofmSUZ5z2h3w1ewm4, local /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.236.html): a literal whose parts are all constant lowers as one constant step, on interp, run and build; quote lowering's constant subtrees likewise. The page recommends the constant step carries a LiteralTerm that holds no function, and GroundValue stays scalar. The tree already has that composite carrier: LiteralTerm (src/literal_term.rs), with an interpreter builder (literal_term_value), a native builder (literal_var) and a canon rendering, used for struct field defaults. Not in scope: read-only lists and maps (a list cell's tail word cannot carry the literal bit, and the collector writes a sharing bit into cells it keeps). Constant tuples are already read-only objects (try_static_struct_literal).

Removes: QuoteLowerer::meta_keys, the per-quote cache of metadata key atoms, which exists only to soften this cost; lower_backend_literal in jobs/native.rs, which duplicates ground_prim.

Proof: the distiller's total requests (tests/distill_telemetry_test.rs, now (46_402, 46_956, 26)) and fixture 00181's event budget (tests/fz2_cli.rs, now 10_163) fall and are lowered; product_drive_test's evaluation count (now 50) does not rise; a fixture shows a constant nested literal reads back the same on all three paths.

Combined by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by Make Distiller Fast, ruling "2. combined") with the runtime emission half: a string literal under SHARED_BIN_THRESHOLD_BYTES is lowered today to fz_alloc_bitstring_const, which allocates and copies at every evaluation (19.6M times per distiller run). It is emitted as a read-only object with the literal bit, as static structs and closures are (native_codegen/static_object.rs). Measured alone (bench, 394fa1313): distiller -3.28% instructions, -3.02% cycles, peak RSS 1407 -> 1286 MB. In-place-writer audit (MDF): none (allocation paths and off-heap SharedBin only). Builder's first check: the suite in a debug build, where the collector asserts literal placement. Reference spike hunk: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-distill-hunt/spike.394fa1313.patch (Prim::ConstBitstring in prim.rs).
title: A literal list, tuple or map whose parts are all constant lowers as one constant
